title: GCM_PINNs: code and trained weights of a physics-informed neural network surrogate model for a general circulation model
description: Code and trained weights for the manuscript "Development and evaluation of a physics-informed neural network surrogate model for a general circulation model" by K. Fukazawa and Y. Miyoshi (submitted to Earth, Planets and Space). The package contains the training and evaluation code of the autoregressive PINN surrogate of a T42, 150-level GCM that contains the region from the ground surface to the exobase, and 13 trained checkpoints (M0-M8, M9 with three seeds, and the solar-forced experiment M2-SZA). The GCM output used for training is available from the authors upon reasonable request.
